title: Page 188
transc:
1 P. M.  Washington July 3d 1863 -
For Orbit As Lee is consent =
= rating his forces near Gettysburg against
Parson all your available forces should
be thrown forward to the assistance
of our main army period Probably
this assistance can be best rendered
by moving rapidly on Lees left
flank compelling him to make detachments
signed Austria Hope orbit will help -


1.15 P. M.  Washington July 3, 1863.
For Adorn As soon as the
<deletion>Ex</deletion> Expedition now out terminates you will 
draw in all your forces to
palate hammer and the defences of
Milan and send to this place
all troops not absolutely required for
the defence of those three places
signed Applause How are you Sheldon
